criteria.text: A workspace holds one search key per engine; switching engines loses neither, and a key saved for one engine is unreachable from another. Rows written before the column keep working through the single-key fallback.

A search task (research, facts, discovery) chooses an engine through searchTaskProviders; an empty map routes nothing and every task keeps the workspace engine. The task is read off the explicit level, except the adaptation review, which names it.
WebSearchClientOptions carries windowDays; Tavily receives time_range and Exa startPublishedDate, category and userLocation. The window rounds up, never down.

Saving settings in included mode changes no search column of the workspace; the included allowance falls back to AI_INCLUDED_MONTHLY_OPERATIONS when no subscription row exists; the screen explains system keys, an own key and its fate, and names a dormant key's engine.

«Откуда идеи» takes a TOPIC subscription checked by one discovery search over a thirty-day window, behind its own LEAD_TOPIC_CHECK_ENABLED switch; repeats create no duplicates, a dismissal is remembered, and an accepted lead carries its source into the piece.

Local acceptance passes (three-app tsc, build, full suite receipt, process verification, design guards); three nullable columns are applied by pointed psql with the validator; the wave is released by the runbook with a release record.
